visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with messy hair and a black shirt holds a woman in a dark, dimly lit room. A red 'REC' icon is visible in the top right corner. (2) A woman in a vibrant yellow, black, and white patterned shirt screams with her mouth wide open. She is suddenly pulled by her feet out of the frame across a light-colored floor. (3) The camera angle shifts to a floor-level shot showing a beige door. The woman's hands reach for the door frame as she is dragged across the tiled floor into the darkness. (4) A close-up of the woman's face shows her looking startled and distressed, followed by rapid shots of her being dragged across different parts of an indoor room with tiled flooring and white walls. (5) The woman lies flat on the tiled floor, looking directly into the camera lens. She speaks while adjusting her hair, her expression shifting from mock-terror to a more casual, questioning look. (6) A series of rapid, rhythmic cuts show the woman being dragged repeatedly in a loop-like fashion against a dark background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Atmospheric, low-frequency suspenseful tones are heard in a dark soundstage. A female voice screams 'Husband!' with high emotional arousal, immediately followed by a sharp, percussive 'Ah!' sound effect. (2) A high-tempo hip-hop track with a heavy sub-bass kick and sharp snare hits starts abruptly. A deep male vocal repeats the hook 'I woke up in a new Bugatti' with a rhythmic, aggressive delivery. (3) The music continues with a strong rhythmic pulse. Repeated sharp 'Ah!' vocal stabs are layered precisely over the beats. High-frequency friction sounds of fabric and sliding are audible under the loud mix. (4) The music ducks significantly in volume. The woman's voice speaks at a moderate pitch and conversational rate with a slightly teasing tone, asking 'Can you be a bit more professional? Why is my husband so smooth?'. (5) The aggressive hip-hop hook returns at full volume with the same percussive 'Ah!' stabs, punctuating a final series of rapid audio slices before the track cuts to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a humorous 're-enactment' video of a recurring social media trend where one person drags another across the floor like a mop, usually set to high-energy music to emphasize the comedic friction and speed.
